clippings.speaker: Akira Kurosawa
clippings.title: Kagemusha
clippings.context: Per Scott McGee's TCM article, Kurosawa wanted to give Shimura, 74 and in the advanced stages of emphysema, a bigger role in Kagemusha but was afraid he would break; the article gives no source for the remark.

notes: Only one usable quote found: no verbatim Shimura-on-Kurosawa line is attributed on a page I could read (MUBI and an IMDb quote are unattributed; the BFI Sight & Sound pieces, the 1964 Kurosawa interview PDFs, and the Richie book were unreachable or redirected). The BFI line 'Shimura played the doctor beautifully' was a fragment and was skipped. Budget exhausted at about 25 tool calls.
